echoParts: it is impossible to please him
for whoever would draw near to God
and that he rewards those who seek him.
verseText: And without faith it is impossible to please him, for whoever would draw near to God must believe that he exists and that he rewards those who seek him.
meaning: If we don't have faith in God, it doesn't matter how good we try to be. The only way to please God is to put our faith and trust in his Son Jesus.
